entities.summary: The Papal Inquisition (1184), Spanish Inquisition (1478), and Roman Inquisition (1542) prosecuted heresy, witchcraft, and blasphemy. Methods included imprisonment, confiscation of property, public penance, and burning at the stake. The Spanish Inquisition was not abolished until 1834 — 650 years of religious prosecution.
